source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U06: Apply demand-notice and objection duties without treating a notice as a completed measure

facts.statement: Ordinary secured-debt route requires stated default/NPA and60-day written notice; notice identifies amount and assets. Debt-security proviso separately dispenses with NPA requirement. Rejected objection reasons communicated within15days; response alone is not section17 trigger.

facts.statement: Courseware outlines enforcement; older redemption wording and placement of management restrictions reconciled against amended primary text rather than repeated.

payload.title: Check the route, then the notice and response
payload.core_explanation_md:
For the ordinary secured-loan route in section 13(2), establish the secured relationship, default and applicable NPA classification before the sixty-day written demand. The notice must identify the amount payable and the secured assets intended for enforcement. Debt securities have a separate proviso; do not copy the ordinary NPA requirement into that branch without checking it.

If a borrower objects, section 13(3A) requires consideration and, where rejected, communication of reasons within fifteen days of receipt. A mechanical rejection note is not a substitute for that consideration. Communicating reasons alone is also not the section 13(4) measure that triggers the section 17 remedy. Registry, exclusion and limitation checks remain necessary.

self_check.prompt_text: Is rejection of an objection itself the same as taking possession?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The notice/response and enforcement-measure stages are distinct.

payload.stem_md: An ordinary secured-loan file proposes possession immediately after sending the demand, with no stipulated expiry of the sixty-day period. Which statutory distinction is missing?

options.text_md: The demand itself always completes a possession measure
options.explanation_md: A demand notice and a later enforcement measure are distinct events.

options.text_md: The demand period and conditions precede recourse to the stated measures
options.explanation_md: Section13 separates demand from the later section13(4) recourse.

options.text_md: An internal overdue label replaces every statutory condition
options.explanation_md: Internal labels do not establish all applicable conditions.

options.text_md: An objection automatically pays the debt
options.explanation_md: A representation is not repayment of the liability.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Section13 separates demand from the later section13(4) recourse.

payload.stem_md: A rejected representation is received by the bank legal team. Which response fits section13(3A)?

options.text_md: Keep only a private rejection note without communicating reasons
options.explanation_md: The provision requires communication of reasons for non-acceptance.

options.text_md: Wait for a completed auction before considering the representation
options.explanation_md: The statutory representation duty occurs at the notice-response stage.

options.text_md: Treat the rejection letter itself as proof of physical possession
options.explanation_md: A response letter is not that separate factual event.

options.text_md: Consider the objection and communicate rejection reasons within the specified fifteen days of receipt
options.explanation_md: The statutory response period is linked to receipt of the representation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statutory response period is linked to receipt of the representation.
